hints.title: Temporal Order
hints.text: Sort the stock price data points chronologically by day.

hints.title: Collinear Slopes Condition
hints.text: Three consecutive points p1, p2, p3 share the same line if and only if their slopes match.

hints.title: Cross-Multiplication to Avoid Float Precision
hints.text: Instead of division, check equality via cross-product: (y2 - y1) * (x3 - x2) == (y3 - y2) * (x2 - x1).

hints.title: Collinear Slope Line Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting by day takes O(n log n); checking slopes takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Floating-point division causes precision errors on large coordinate differences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sort requires constant extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses integer cross-multiplication rather than floating-point slope division.
